topics.instruction: Launch into built-in synthetic community content.
Built-in Riverside content is synthetic demo content.
No developer account or login is required.
Create a local community from the community switcher.
Join with a valid Riot reference or scan a QR code.
Compose, review, sign, and persist an update.
Restart and confirm the local community remains available.
Read locally retained community records without a network.
Camera and nearby permissions are requested only for their named actions.
Nearby claims require named physical-device pair evidence before publication.
Denying permission leaves an actionable retry path.
Invalid join input is rejected with recovery guidance.
Nearby discovery with no peers remains a recoverable empty state.
